why: The criterion holds for all seven expect lines. Each one can be checked at the PR head with local files only. Five use `run` proofs with local node one-liners against ./index.js or README.md, or with `npm test` (the exports check, the '00042' results for string and number input, no truncation for '12345' and '123456', and the test-suite result). The README line is a regex check for a `## name(` heading per export plus a narrow read that the padLeft section describes left-padding to a width with a fill character. The tests line is a read of test/strutil.test.js for a test() that calls padLeft. Each line has one clear answer a single careful reader can give. Nothing needs a release, deploy or published page, and the non_goals rule out "Publishing a new npm release or bumping the package version."
